pokedexEntries.bk: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

pokedexEntries.wh: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

pokedexEntries.x: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

pokedexEntries.or: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
